notes: SwarmPeg is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 whole tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers are fee-free; there are no administrative powers or subsequent mint or burn entry points. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
